evidence_items.locator: Paragraph discussing Madison's notes and OpenAI's future governance
evidence_items.explanation: The original interview identifies an elected representative body. It prevents treating every later corporate oversight committee as the board contemplated by this claim.
The announcement documents changes to OpenAI's corporate board before Marcus's post. It does not document the globally representative elected body described in 2016.

evidence_items.locator: Section 5, Unifying Our Safety Frameworks for Model Development and Monitoring
evidence_items.explanation: The announcement describes substantive committee oversight, including authority to delay releases elsewhere in the same disclosure. This matters against a broad claim that company governance can never have powers, but it does not establish the representative external board that triggers this forecast.
The restructuring announcement describes nonprofit control of the business. It does not establish a board elected by broad parts of the world or resolve the forecast's government-mandate exception.

unresolved_gaps: No evidence establishes that the specifically described representative board materialized by the evaluation date.
The search does not conclusively establish nonexistence throughout the entire period.
There are no governing documents for a qualifying board from which to assess its powers and the mandate exception.
